result.title: CARD: Closing the Teacher-Student Loop for Adversarial Robustness Distillation
result.summary: Adversarial robustness distillation typically treats a robust teacher as a fixed knowledge source and transfers robustness to a compact student in a one-way manner. This paradigm terminates teacher-student interaction once the student is distilled, thereby discarding potentially useful feedback from the distilled student. However, exploiting such feedback is nontrivial because indiscriminate weak-to-strong transfer may propagate student errors to the teacher. To address this issue, we propose Cyclic Adversarial Robustness Distillation (CARD), a closed-loop framework that turns the distilled student into a feedback source for refining the robust teacher and subsequently transfers the teacher gains back to the same student. CARD first performs strong-to-weak adversarial distillation and then uses reliability-enhanced student feedback to refine the robust teacher. The refinement combines inverse adversarial student feedback with teacher-student discrepancy maximization, after which the refined teacher is used to continue training the same student under the unchanged base distillation objective. We further establish a sample-level sufficient condition for reliable weak-to-strong feedback transfer and derive a distribution-level upper bound on the refined teacher's risk. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet-10 across multiple teacher-student architectures and base distillation methods show that CARD improves adversarial robustness in most evaluated settings while generally preserving clean accuracy. These results show that the distilled student can provide useful feedback to the teacher, enabling robustness transfer to proceed beyond the conventional one-way teacher-to-student paradigm.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CARD 闭环对抗鲁棒性蒸馏框架：先用可靠性增强的学生反馈反向精炼鲁棒教师，再用精炼后的教师继续训练同一学生，并在 CIFAR 等数据集上验证鲁棒性提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属对抗鲁棒性蒸馏，讨论的是图像分类下的师生训练范式与反馈可靠性，未涉及视觉或多模态推理的内部状态、证据使用与停止决策；其师生回路属于训练期权重传递，而非推理期状态生成或更新，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
